samples.summary: New destination-clearing loop deletes cells without the `spillAnchor` guard used elsewhere in the same method, so it can orphan spill ghost cells
samples.evidence: The pre-existing source-clearing loop skips spill cells at packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:2350-2352 (`if (sourceCell?.spillAnchor) continue;`). The new loop at sheet.ts:2382-2393 unconditionally `store.delete(ref)` / `store.set(ref,{s})`, bypassing that guard and the ghost cleanup `setGrid` performs for spill anchors (sheet.ts:1119-1162). A destination cell under the moved merge that is a spill ghost, or a spill anchor whose ghosts extend outside the merge, is left with dangling spill state. Fix belongs on the new code in moveRangeTo.

samples.summary: Cut-paste reaches the same cell-relocation operation with no merge guard or propagation, so merge corruption is still reachable via Ctrl+X/Ctrl+V
samples.evidence: `Sheet.paste` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:2112-2215) implements the same move semantics — setGrid at 2167, source clearing at 2196-2205, `redirectFormulasForCut` at 2207 — with no `getMergesIntersecting` check and no merge relocation. Cutting a merged block still leaves the merge at the source and writes content into merge-covered destination cells, violating the 'covered cells hold no content' invariant the new code at sheet.ts:2378-2393 now depends on. docs/tasks/active/20260822-sheet-move-merge-propagation-lessons.md:20 acknowledges this as out of scope; flagged because the two relocation paths now disagree about the invariant.

samples.summary: `moveRangeTo` can now silently no-op on rejected merge cases, but its only caller cannot detect it and shows no feedback
samples.evidence: packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:4309-4314 awaits `sheet.moveRangeTo(...)` (returns `Promise<void>`), clears the preview and re-renders, assuming success. The new early returns at sheet.ts:2294-2303 make a drop onto a partially covered merged block a silent no-op, while the drag preview still highlights that drop target as valid (worksheet.ts:4203-4215). Returning a boolean/reason, or rejecting the drop target in the preview, would keep the view consistent.

samples.summary: Merge snapshot taken before several awaits can go stale if a remote change replaces `this.merges` mid-move
samples.evidence: Merges are read at sheet.ts:2293-2300, then `fetchGrid`, `setGrid`, style writes and store reads are awaited before the merge mutation at sheet.ts:2364-2395. `Worksheet.reloadDimensions` replaces `this.merges` via `sheet.loadMerges()` (packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:5180), driven by remote Yorkie ops that include `$.sheets.*.merges` (packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/remote-change-utils.ts:6). A concurrent remote merge edit during a local drag-move would make the delete/recreate pass act on stale anchors.

finding.summary: New destination-clearing loop deletes cells without the `spillAnchor` guard used elsewhere in the same method, so it can orphan spill ghost cells
finding.evidence: The pre-existing source-clearing loop skips spill cells at packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:2350-2352 (`if (sourceCell?.spillAnchor) continue;`). The new loop at sheet.ts:2382-2393 unconditionally `store.delete(ref)` / `store.set(ref,{s})`, bypassing that guard and the ghost cleanup `setGrid` performs for spill anchors (sheet.ts:1119-1162). A destination cell under the moved merge that is a spill ghost, or a spill anchor whose ghosts extend outside the merge, is left with dangling spill state. Fix belongs on the new code in moveRangeTo.

verdict.reason: Verified in-repo. The new merge-coverage clearing loop in moveRangeTo (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:2382-2393) unconditionally does store.set(ref,{s}) / store.delete(ref) for covered cells, while the sibling source-clearing loop in the same method guards spill cells at sheet.ts:2351 (`if (sourceCell?.spillAnchor) continue;`). The consequence relies on assumptions outside the diff: ghost cells are read-only in setData (sheet.ts:1041), removeData (sheet.ts:1119) and autofill (sheet.ts:2564), and ghost reclamation is only ever driven from the anchor's spillRows/spillCols (calculator.ts:71-85, sheet.ts:1046-1062, 1126-1140). So deleting a spill anchor under the moved merge whose ghosts extend outside it strands ghosts that no path can clear, and deleting a ghost leaves the anchor's spill metadata inconsistent. Nothing guards this: the only preconditions are the merge-containment checks at sheet.ts:2293-2303, and canMergeSelection (sheet.ts:4260-4274) never considers spill state. Sheet.setGrid (sheet.ts:944-946) is a bare pass-through and performs no ghost cleanup, so the reviewer's incidental citation of "setGrid cleanup at 1119-1162" is mislabeled (that range is removeData) — this does not change the substance. mergeSelection (sheet.ts:4306-4318) shows the same unguarded pattern, i.e. pre-existing parity, but pre-existing scope is not a refutation ground and the finding is real and reachable via drag-move.

finding.evidence: `Sheet.paste` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:2112-2215) implements the same move semantics — setGrid at 2167, source clearing at 2196-2205, `redirectFormulasForCut` at 2207 — with no `getMergesIntersecting` check and no merge relocation. Cutting a merged block still leaves the merge at the source and writes content into merge-covered destination cells, violating the 'covered cells hold no content' invariant the new code at sheet.ts:2378-2393 now depends on. docs/tasks/active/20260822-sheet-move-merge-propagation-lessons.md:20 acknowledges this as out of scope; flagged because the two relocation paths now disagree about the invariant.

verdict.reason: The code is present as quoted (paste at sheet.ts:2112-2219 relocates cells with no merge handling), but it is not a blast-radius defect. (a) paste never mutates merge metadata — the only merge writers in the file are the new moveRangeTo pass (sheet.ts:2366-2376) and mergeSelection/unmergeSelection (sheet.ts:4320, 4361-4362) — so `merges`/`mergeCoverMap` remain mutually consistent and the split/duplicate/dangling-merge corruption the new guards at sheet.ts:2293-2303 block is NOT reachable through Ctrl+X/Ctrl+V; paste is not another entry point into the guarded relocation, it never relocates merges at all. (b) The claim that the new code "depends on" the covered-cells-hold-no-content invariant is wrong: sheet.ts:2382-2393 establishes that invariant itself, unconditionally clearing or style-stripping every covered destination cell it did not overwrite, so content a paste had hidden under a merge is cleaned up rather than breaking the new code. (c) Writing content into merge-covered destination cells is pre-existing behaviour of plain paste as well (sheet.ts:2153-2167), untouched by the diff and an explicitly documented non-goal (todo.md:60), i.e. a feature gap in a separate path rather than a changed contract with an unupdated caller, a removed export, or a bypassable new guard — outside this lens's lane.
